provenance.note: values RE-READ from the historical R7 estimability package in the V45 transfer; not recomputed from raw counts here

population.caution: the 1,561-cell subset spans 15 operators, but the MICROGLIA come from 2. This is not 15-operator validation.

PRIMARY_FINDING.superseded_claim: 'measurement repeatability tracks the R7 outcome; the rank agreement is EXACT'
PRIMARY_FINDING.why_it_was_wrong: the ranks are NOT in agreement. APOE is rank 1 on both, but HLA-DRA and P2RY12 are INVERTED: HLA-DRA has HIGHER repeatability (.394 vs .364) and LOWER increment (+.008 vs +.009). My own script PRINTED Spearman = +0.500 and I wrote 'exact' in the next sentence - I read past my own output, which is the exact failure mode I had been correcting elsewhere this cycle.
PRIMARY_FINDING.corrected_statement: an ASSOCIATION worth investigating, not an explanation. It is dominated entirely by APOE; the other two are effectively tied, separated by .001 in increment, and inverted in rank. Three programs.

MY_HYPOTHESIS_NOT_SUPPORTED.hypothesis: Thrupp 2020 nuclear depletion of APOE/APOC1/CST3/SPP1/CD74 explains the R7 failures
MY_HYPOTHESIS_NOT_SUPPORTED.prediction: the depleted targets should measure WORST in single nuclei
MY_HYPOTHESIS_NOT_SUPPORTED.observed: APOE, which contains BOTH depleted genes (APOE and partner APOC1), measures BEST of the three; P2RY12, which is NOT depleted, measures WORST
MY_HYPOTHESIS_NOT_SUPPORTED.verdict: the within-dataset ordering is OPPOSITE to the prediction
MY_HYPOTHESIS_NOT_SUPPORTED.what_this_does_NOT_show: Thrupp is a claim about depletion RELATIVE TO WHOLE CELLS. APOE can be depleted versus a whole-cell assay AND still be the best-measured of these three within nuclei. These data refute my USE of Thrupp to explain the within-dataset ordering; they do not refute Thrupp.

evidence: 40-43% of microglia have a zero program count
only 98-132 of 361 cells have BOTH half-partitions positive
R8's fixed 8-gene reference abstains on 90/361 cells
RELIABILITY_GATE_VERDICT.consequence: no teacher should be fitted to these targets as per-nucleus states on this subset

THIRD_CLASSIFICATION_RESERVED.label: MEASURED_BUT_BIOLOGICALLY_UNINFORMATIVE
THIRD_CLASSIFICATION_RESERVED.why: that verdict requires the independent-readout test, which has not run. Sparse counts establish neither success nor biological failure.

repeatability_metric_caveat: the thinning proxy is a single simulated partition of the SAME molecules. It measures molecule-sampling stability, retains cell-level technical effects, and is NOT independent biological reproducibility. R8 states this explicitly and it is not upgraded here.

R8_SPLIT_HALF_ACTIVITY_CORRELATIONS.reading: restricted to nuclei where the program IS detected, HLA-DRA and P2RY12 both go NEGATIVE - the two halves of the same molecules anti-correlate. APOE alone stays positive at .328. This is more directly relevant to R8's structured target than the R7 thinning proxy.
R8_SPLIT_HALF_ACTIVITY_CORRELATIONS.caveat_from_R8_not_upgraded: these are molecule-partition results, not independent biological replication, and R8 warns that selection on observed positivity introduces additional interpretive bias - so the negative values are not purely a noise measurement.
